description: After you hit or avoid a trap returned by lookup_traps or search_traps, record whether it is still true. Confirmations raise a trap's trust score and disputes lower it; several disputes send it back for review. One vote per trap per 30 days. Needs a free API key.

hours_lost.description: Optional hours the trap cost before the fix was found.

still_true.description: true if the trap happened as described, false if it no longer happens.

trap_id.description: The trap id from a lookup or search result, e.g. "fg-0158".

version_seen.description: Optional SDK, API or tool version where you saw it, e.g. "stripe-node 22.3.0".

name: confirm_trap
title: Confirm or dispute a trap
